description: Diagnose the "heldfast-churn-placeholder" sources rather than search them: compare files on disk with the index for coverage, missing or stale files, source rules that match nothing, and index concentration. Use it when results look incomplete; ragmir_status is the quicker readiness check. With knowledge:true it audits the indexed Markdown pages as a knowledge base instead: broken links, missing and unlinked pages, duplicate titles, broken citations, and derived pages whose sources changed. Returns a summary unless detail:true.

assumeRemoved.description: With knowledge: also report what removing these pages would break.

detail.description: true lists every affected path instead of counts and the first examples.

knowledge.description: true audits the indexed Markdown pages instead: broken links, missing and unlinked pages, duplicate titles, broken citations, and pages whose declared sources changed or left.

maxBytes.description: Output budget in bytes for this call; the server caps it at its configured maximum.

paths.description: With knowledge: audit only these pages, folders, files, or globs.
